  • Class
    Description
    CellState
    State a board cell can be in at any point during the game.
    Coordinate
    Represents a (row, column) position within the 10x10 board.
    GameClock
    Independent thread that works as the game's stopwatch: every second it updates (via Platform.runLater(java.lang.Runnable)) a Label with the time elapsed since the shooting turns started.
    GamePhase
    Phase the game is currently in.
    GameSession
    Holds session data that needs to be passed from the start screen (StartController) to the game board (GameController) without coupling the two controllers to each other.
    GameTurn
    Whose turn it is to fire.
    Orientation
    Direction a ship extends from the cell the player clicks on (that cell is always the bow).
    ShipType
    Ship types defined by the assignment, with the size (number of cells it occupies) and how many units of it each fleet has.
    ShotResult
    Immediate result of firing at a coordinate on the board.
    SoundManager
    Single point for the background music and the short sound effects (button hover/click) of the whole application.
